storm.title: ER storm return period conflict (10-yr vs 20-yr)
storm.statement: ER internal conflict on storm return period: Table 7-8 / §7.5.3 state 10-yr for city networks (p.43) while body text cites 20-yr (p.43, 46). Until RCRC answers the RFI (DQ-13 / DQ-15), W6 applies 10-yr and reports this Observation.

storm.title: ER storm min velocity conflict (0.61 vs 0.9 m/s)
storm.statement: ER internal conflict on storm minimum velocity: §7.5.7 gives 0.61 – 3.66 m/s while p.46 cites 0.9 m/s half-full. Until answered (DQ-15), W6 applies §7.5.7 and reports this Observation.

storm.title: ER storm MH spacing conflict (Table 7-11 vs ≤ 80 m)
storm.statement: ER internal conflict on storm MH spacing: Table 7-11 (70–100 / 100–120 m) vs ≤ 80 m on the same page. Until answered (DQ-15), W6 applies Table 7-11 and reports this Observation.

storm.title: ER storm cover conflict (1.2 vs ~1.0 m)
storm.statement: ER internal conflict on storm cover: §7.5.8 requires ≥ 1.2 m while p.47 cites ~1.0 m. Until answered (DQ-15), W6 applies 1.2 m and reports this Observation.
